Search the password manager by title, tag name or folder name. Returns id, title, tag names, folder name and whether the entry has a one-time code. It never returns usernames, addresses or any secret, and there is no way to read one.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, the tag names and the folder name of an entry; every word must match.

tag.description: Only entries that carry this tag.

limit.description: At most this many entries (at most 50, 20 by default).

Call it first to learn where to list or search. A storage the user names but that is not listed can be used as "storage:<name>"; holzi asks the user then.
List the entries of a folder: name, path, kind (file or dir), size in bytes and the time of the last change. At most `limit` entries (500 by default); `truncated` says there are more.

Filters: `types`, `sizeMin`/`sizeMax` in bytes, `modifiedAfter`/`modifiedBefore` as YYYY-MM-DD. At most 500 hits, best first; the search stops after 30 seconds, and `truncated` says it did not finish. Hidden files are left out.

An image is shown to you if your model accepts images. For anything else, a scanned PDF or a file over 50 MB you get the details of the file and a `note` why there is no text.

placeA.description: The source. Its .haex-ignore file holds the exclusions of the rule.

direction.description: aToB: one way from the source (placeA) to the target (placeB); both: both ways.

deleteMode.description: What a deletion on one side does on the other: mirror it into the trash, keep the file, or ask the user.

intervalSecs.description: How often the rule runs, 60 to 86400 seconds.

allowDecrypted.description: Files of an encrypted source may be stored decrypted in the target. The user sees it in the confirmation.

Search the address book by name, organization, phone number or e-mail address. Returns id, name, organization, phone numbers, e-mail addresses and group names of each match. The contact marked isSelf is the user themselves. Needs the user to allow reading contacts.

query.description: Text a match contains; case and accents do not matter, phone numbers also match as bare digits.

limit.description: At most this many contacts (at most 100, 20 by default).

description: Read one contact with all its values (phone numbers, addresses, dates, …) and their ids. The contact marked isSelf is the user themselves. Needs the user to allow reading contacts.

Change the name, organization, note or values of one contact. Only the fields given change; a value with an id from contacts.get is changed, one without an id is added, ids in `remove` are removed. The change reaches every device and the phone address books like one made in holzi. Needs the user to allow changing contacts.

givenName.description: The new text; an empty text clears the field.

familyName.description: The new text; an empty text clears the field.

displayName.description: The new text; an empty text clears the field.

organization.description: The new text; an empty text clears the field.

jobTitle.description: The new text; an empty text clears the field.

note.description: The new text; an empty text clears the field.

kind.description: phone, email, address, url, date, im, relation, custom or a kind of a newer holzi.

values.description: Values to change (with id) or add (without id).

description: Turn one contact into a text (a link) that the user can hand to someone else. Data leaves the vault with it, so the user is shown what goes along in a dialog on every call, may change the choice or decline, and you get the text only for what they left chosen; a refusal comes back as denied_by_user. `selection` is only a proposal and cannot reach beyond what the dialog offers: leave it out to propose everything, or name the ids of the values (from contacts.get) and set the head fields you do not want to false. Needs the user to allow reading contacts.

selection.description: What you propose to share; anything left out is proposed as shared.

values.description: Ids of the values (contacts.get) that go along.

holzi.description: Which confirmed holzi addresses to propose: none, the stored card, or selected own-vault devices and relays.

devices.description: Device public keys for the own-vault card.

relays.description: Nostr relay URLs for the own-vault card.
